content: SHIPPED + critic-clean (167b9f4 + #148 completion fd67cd3). The cast-< parse bug the off-corpus TV generator SURFACED: x as u32 < 33 mis-parsed as a generic-arg list (u32<...>) in Verus/Rust — also hit forge check (a real production bug, not just TV). Critic found the fix was incomplete on the struct-invariant path -> #148 fixed it (shared helper, both sites uniform). Corpus goldens byte-identical. The payoff: TV-over-generated-clauses found a bug the 5 guard layers missed.
